channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: AWS Acquires DuckDB
item.description: DuckLabs provides services around the DuckDB in-process OLAP data management system directly from its main developers. (3 sources: hackernews, lobsters, rprogramming)

item.title: Amazon EC2 X8i instances are now available in additional regions
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) X8i instances are available in the Europe (Milan) and Europe (Spain) regions. These instances are powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors available only on AWS. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery introduces Recovery Plans for orchestrated application recovery
item.description: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS) now offers Recovery Plans, a capability that automates the sequential launch of multi-server applications during recovery and drills. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP now supports copying backups across AWS Regions and accounts
item.description: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, a fully managed shared storage service built on NetApp's popular ONTAP file system, now supports copying backups within and across AWS Regions, and across trusted accounts in your AWS organization. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Redshift integrates with Agent Toolkit for AWS for AI-assisted data warehouse management
item.description: Amazon Redshift now integrates with the Agent Toolkit for AWS , enabling you to build, query, troubleshoot, and migrate to Amazon Redshift data warehouses and date lakes directly from AI agents such as Claude Code, Kiro, and Cursor. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Google Cloud Launches AI-powered Agents to Simplify Database Lifecycle Management
item.description: Google Cloud has introduced AI-powered Database Operations Agents, featuring an Onboarding Agent that streamlines database setup and an Observability Agent that helps automate troubleshooting, performance optimization, and tuning. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AWS Introduces Specification Driven Composition for Flexible Data Workflows
item.description: AWS describes a specification-driven approach for composing flexible data workflows by separating intent from processing logic. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer expands conversational analytics capabilities in the Africa (Cape Town) Region
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now supports generative AI-powered summaries, real-time call analytics, and real-time rules in the Africa (Cape Town) Region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer now automatically refreshes scheduling metrics
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now automatically refreshes schedule metrics on the scheduling page, giving managers immediate visibility into the impact of schedule updates. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Cloudflare Wallets Arrives Late to x402, and the Spending Controls Stop at the Payment
item.description: Cloudflare announced Wallets, giving agents a stablecoin balance and spending controls, though only handle claiming is live and squatting complaints have already surfaced. Payments run on x402, now hosted by the Linux Foundation. (1 source: infoq)
